- Jonas: can you take the behavioral write-up (2-3 bullet summary + risk callouts)?
- Marissa: can you own the competency justification (especially product/infra gaps)?
- Mina or Tessa: who can take the hiring committee one-pager? (needs 4–5 line recommendation + suggested calibration language)

Attachment: candidate_scorecard.pdf (blank fields for late voters)
Attachment: avery_resume.pdf
